chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him say concerning Salat al-Jumu'ah: there is no harm in reciting in it other than Surat al-Jumu'ah and al-Munafiqun, if you are in haste.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مُسْتَعْجِلًا: being in haste or pressed for time

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite other than Surat al-Jumu'ah and al-Munafiqun in Salat al-Jumu'ah if one is in a hurry?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the recitation in Salat al-Jumu'ah. It indicates that although Surat al-Jumu'ah and al-Munafiqun are the well-known recitations for this prayer, it is permissible to recite other surahs when one is in haste.
